name: Applab
Description: This application allows users to create accounts, manage profiles, upload profile images, and view public user profiles. It also includes a real-time global chat with live messages, typing indicators, reactions, quoted replies, and message editing or deletion.

name: Blog Application
Description: This is a public blog platform where users can create, edit, and delete blog posts after signing in. It also includes profile management and interactive features such as likes and comments.

name: CSS Grid Tutorial
Description: This is a CSS tutorial focused on the grid layout system. It includes a search functionality and examples for each topic. Users can edit and execute example code in real-time using an integrated code editor.

name: Cards
Description: This is a single-page application developed without using any traditional frameworks or libraries. I implemented a custom single-page router. The application allows users to create, edit, and delete individual cards.
